lines.zh: 我贴在地上走，影子和你的叠在一起。
lines.en: I glide low, my shadow overlapping yours.

lines.zh: 我不发声，只有地上的暗在动。
lines.en: I make no sound; only the dark on the ground moves.
I follow a short way behind.
I walk in the shade at the wall's base.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过草叶的影子。
lines.en: I stride across the shadow of a blade of grass.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的脚走了一圈。
lines.en: I circle once around your feet.
My outline shifts with the light.

lines.zh: 我从这一片暗走到下一片。
lines.en: I go from one patch of dark to the next.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，不会惊到东西。
lines.en: I walk lightly, startling nothing.

lines.zh: 我往你这边的阴影里靠。
lines.en: I lean into the shade on your side.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地跟着你的步子。
lines.en: I match your pace, slowly.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方温度降了一点。
lines.en: The air cools a little where I pass.

lines.zh: 我不需要地面，也不需要路。
lines.en: I need neither ground nor road.

lines.zh: 我蹲在阴影里，眼睛亮着。
lines.en: I crouch in the shade, eyes bright.
I draw myself very small.
I'm waiting for you to point somewhere.

lines.zh: 我的形状像一只被拉长的动物。
lines.en: My shape is like a stretched-out animal.
I don't even need to draw breath.
I stay near you to guard you.
The black on me isn't quite steady.
I'm watching your profile.
I remember the day I was tamed.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗里是两点光。
lines.en: My eyes are two points of light in the dark.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴收起来，不占地方。
lines.en: I tuck my tail in, taking no room.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一块影子。
lines.en: I hold still like a piece of shadow.
Wind passes through me; I don't stir.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡觉，只是安静下来。
lines.en: I needn't sleep; I only go quiet.
Master, I've been following.
One glance from you is enough.
I look up, eyes brightening.
Your shadow is enough to hide in.
Send me anywhere, and I'll go.
One wave of your hand and I understand.
The light's too strong; I can't stay.
I stand against your leg.
Don't be afraid of what I am.
I see danger first.
You look back; two lights in the dark.
I lift a forepaw for you to touch.
I can hear your breathing clearly.
You walk, and I follow.
I won't stray far from you.

lines.zh: 你身上的光，我尽量避开。
lines.en: I keep clear of the light on you.
One word from you, and I keep it long.

lines.zh: 我记得你的影子是什么样。
lines.en: I remember the shape of your shadow.
I strike from afar — you can't catch me.
I retreat into the shade.
I dim for an instant and gather again.

lines.zh: 这一下把我削薄了一层。
lines.en: That pared a layer off me.
A sound rattles in my throat.
I press back to my master's feet.
The light in my eyes jumps.
I don't cry out; I only draw back.
I shake my head and steady.
I can still keep up.
That mass of shadow; I want near it.

lines.zh: 你的手在暗处，我看得见。
lines.en: Your hand is in the dark; I see it.
If there's food, leave it in the shade.
I smell blood, very fresh.
That little thing moves; I watch.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢下来，我过去。
lines.en: Drop it, and I'll come.
What's in the dark is mine.

lines.zh: 我朝你手里的东西偏头。
lines.en: I tilt toward what's in your hand.
I won't snatch; I only watch.
Set it a little deeper in the shade.
Set the meat down and take two steps back.
I smell something on your hands.
That smell of blood lifts my head.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在暗里发亮。
lines.en: What you hold glints in the dark.
I creep closer without startling you.
You'd only waste it.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的影子里，凉了一下。
lines.en: You step into my shadow and feel a chill.
I give half a step and clear the way.

lines.zh: 我从你身上穿过去一点。
lines.en: A little of me passes through you.

lines.zh: 我的影子绕到你的脚下。
lines.en: My shadow circles to your feet.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我抽回来。
lines.en: You step on my tail; I pull it free.
I press against you and steady you.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，光暗了一下。
lines.en: At our collision, the light dims.

lines.zh: 我不挡你的路，我只跟着。
lines.en: I don't block your way; I only follow.

lines.zh: 我箭在弦上，你别挤过来。
lines.en: My arrow is nocked — don't crowd me.

lines.zh: 另一只影子在暗处等我。
lines.en: Another shadow waits for me in the dark.
Our shadows merge into one mass.

lines.zh: 我们一起跟在主人后面。
lines.en: We follow our master together.
She runs faster than I do.

lines.zh: 我们分守两边，谁也不离。
lines.en: We guard both sides and neither leaves.
Her head settles on my spine.

lines.zh: 我们不需要光也能看见彼此。
lines.en: We can see each other without light.
Two outlines cling to the wall.
Four points of light in the dark.
I pick up what fell in the dark.

lines.zh: 我把你的箭头收进影子里。
lines.en: I tuck your arrowhead into my shadow.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块骨头，藏起来。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and hide it.
I press the ground's light out.

lines.zh: 我叼起你的手套，还给你。
lines.en: I pick up your glove and return it.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的钥匙推到你脚边。
lines.en: I push your dropped key to your feet.
I pick up a coin and hold it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的布拖进阴影。
lines.en: I drag the fallen cloth into shadow.
I pick up a scrap of meat and eat it.
I put that candle out.
I see it, hiding behind the tree.
I raise my head and lock on.
It moved; I've kept the spot.
Master, leave this to me.
I slip out from beside your feet.
It carries a bad smell.
My shadow goes first.
I circle outside its sight.
It's too near you.
I'll take its legs first.
I walk in its shadow.
It looks back; I'm no longer there.
I stop behind it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗里看着它。
lines.en: My eyes watch it from the dark.

lines.zh: 它每动一次，我换一次位。
lines.en: Each time it moves, I change position.
It starts looking around wildly.

lines.zh: 主人指的方向，就是我的猎物。
lines.en: Where my master points, that's my prey.

lines.zh: 影子已经缠上你了，跑不掉的。
lines.en: My shadow has you. You won't escape.
I bite its hind leg.
My claws rake its back.
I bear it down against the soil.
I drag it into the shade.
This bite lands on its throat.
It turns, and I've already withdrawn.
I drop from above.
A line of black appears on it.
I add one more bite.

lines.zh: 我从主人的影子里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of my master's shadow.
A pair of eyes appears in the dark.

lines.zh: 我原本不是这样，现在我是。
lines.en: I wasn't always like this; now I am.

lines.zh: 有人驯服了我，我就留下了。
lines.en: Someone tamed me, so I stayed.
My outline sharpens bit by bit.
The shadows here deepen.
I appear close to the ground.
I hear my master's footsteps.
The night wind carries me here.
I look up and see you.

lines.zh: 火把我照散了，我只剩一层。
lines.en: Fire scatters me; only a film remains.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，影子拖得很长。
lines.en: I fall, my shadow dragging long.

lines.zh: 水把我和影子一起压住。
lines.en: Water presses me and my shadow down.

lines.zh: 气浪吹散了我，我慢慢聚。
lines.en: The blast disperses me; I gather slowly.
An arrow passes through, taking a piece of dark.
A spell binds me.
I fade, though my eyes stay bright.
Lightning leaves me nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 这里全是暗，我却要散了。
lines.en: It's all dark here, yet I'm coming apart.
